Hatterene

Psychic Fairy

Galar · Generation 8

Hatterene is a Psychic/Fairy-type Silent Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 5.1 kg. It evolves from Hattrem. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (136), with a base stat total of 510.
